narration.service: edge-tts 7.3.1 / Microsoft online neural voice service
narration.authorisation: User explicitly authorised online speech and requested four full narration choices.
narration.identity: Synthetic named service voices; no public-person voice clone or endorsement.
narration.cache: Exact text, voice, rate and pitch fingerprints; measured clips retained in production/{voice}/clips outside the deployable site.
narration.timing: Voice-specific cue clocks measured from the generated audio. 0.8s opening, 0.3s between cues plus scripted prediction holds, 0.8s ending.

music.source: Original programmatically composed sparse plucked motif, retained from the approved Studio v3 sound design; no third-party recording or downloaded music sample.
music.mix: Narration normalised to -17 LUFS target / -2 dBTP target. Very quiet original bed mixed underneath with opening and ending fades. Actual peak and RMS checks recorded in review-course/audio-checks.json.

subtitles.alignment: Measured semantic cue boundaries for each selected voice. Balanced short caption chunks receive proportional reading time with a minimum display-time allowance. This is not word-level translation alignment.
subtitles.review: AI translation with numerical and terminology checks; no native-language human review claimed.
